help_q1: How do I add a new medicine?
help_a1: Go to Search, look up the medicine, and if it's not found you'll see an Add Medicine button to enter it manually with a photo.
help_q2: Why does a medicine have no image?
help_a2: Medicines pulled automatically from the public drug database don't include photos. You can add one yourself from the Inventory tab.
help_q3: Can I use the app in another language?
help_a3: Yes — go to Settings and choose from English, Arabic, French, German, or Turkish.
